def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque, Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0]); bg=9
    mask=[[g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
    vis=[[False]*C for _ in range(R)]
    comps=[]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if mask[i][j] and not vis[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); vis[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and mask[nr][nc] and not vis[nr][nc]:
                            vis[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(cells)
    shapes=[]
    for cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        sub=tuple(tuple(g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
        shapes.append(sub)
    cnt=Counter(shapes)
    best=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [list(row) for row in best]

def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque, Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0]); bg=9
    mask=[[g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(C)] for i in range(R)]
    vis=[[False]*C for _ in range(R)]
    comps=[]
    for i in range(R):
        for j in range(C):
            if mask[i][j] and not vis[i][j]:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); vis[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while q:
                    r,c=q.popleft(); cells.append((r,c))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=nr<R and 0<=nc<C and mask[nr][nc] and not vis[nr][nc]:
                            vis[nr][nc]=True; q.append((nr,nc))
                comps.append(cells)
    shapes=[]
    for cells in comps:
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        sub=tuple(tuple(g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)) for r in range(r0,r1+1))
        shapes.append(sub)
    cnt=Counter(shapes)
    rep=[s for s in shapes if cnt[s]>1]
    best=rep[0] if rep else shapes[0]
